comment: For each rubrique of the EDII nomenclature: the entries of décret n° 2005-1991 it may fall under (A: annexe 1 catégorie A, B: catégorie B, CDC: annexe 2), each with the condition it depends on ('when'), and optionally the case of the rubrique it applies to ('case', the start of that case's label). The decree classes units by their main activity, while the nomenclature lists activities and substances inside a unit: a link is a reading, so the page shows it as a suggestion with its condition and the user chooses. 'note' says what applies when no link fits.
